Name: M 93 - Anthony Crowell, City Planning Commission.
Title: RESOLUTION APPROVING THE APPOINTMENT BY THE MAYOR OF ANTHONY CROWELL AS A MEMBER OF THE NEW YORK CITY PLANNING COMMISSION.
BodyName: Committee on Rules, Privileges, Elections, Standards and Ethics

History.Description: This Resolution was Approved by Committee
History.BodyName: Committee on Rules, Privileges, Elections, Standards and Ethics

Text: RESOLVED, Pursuant to Sections 31 and 192 of the New York City Charter, the Council hereby approves the appointment by the Mayor of Anthony Crowell as a member of the New York City Planning Commission to serve the remainder of a five-year term that will expire on June 30, 2029.

\b\par

RESOLVED, Pursuant to Sections 31 and 192 of the New York City Charter, the Council hereby approves the appointment by the Mayor of Anthony Crowell as a member of the New York City Planning Commission to serve the remainder of a five-year term that will expire on June 30, 2029.\par
